intent: Render a Combobox's current value where the field itself does not show it, as the chosen label, a placeholder, or whatever a function of the value returns.
typical_uses: One ComboboxChip per chosen value inside ComboboxChips

dont_use_when.situation: Showing the chosen item of a single-line field

instead.note: The field's own text already shows the chosen item's label.

invariants.text: A function child is called with the current value (an array with `multiple`) and its result rendered; a node child is rendered as given; with no children it renders `placeholder` while nothing is chosen (null, or an empty array under `multiple`) and the root's `items` give no label for a null value, and otherwise the chosen item's label, or the chosen labels with `multiple`, looked up in the root's `items`.

children.states: children is either React nodes or a function of the current value returning React nodes
children.because: `ReactNode | ((selectedValue: any) => ReactNode)` - a React node and a function have no JSON Schema representation.

placeholder.states: placeholder is the React content shown while nothing is chosen and no children are given
placeholder.because: `ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more, which the compiler cannot state as one JSON type.

bad.title: A value outside any Combobox
bad.why: The primitive's Value reads the nearest Combobox root's state through context and throws when there is none.
